statement:
∀ (S : Set (Space n × ℝ)), IsOpen S →
Set.EqOn (Function.uncurry u) (fun _ => q) S →
∀ p ∈ S, Function.uncurry u =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun _ => q)
proof:
intro S hS hu p hp
exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hS.mem_nhds hp) (fun z hz => hu hz)

checked : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : Space n → ℝ → Space m) (q : Space m),
  1 ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ m →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry u) (timeDomain n) →
      (∀ (s t : ℝ), 0 < s → s < t → ∃ C, IsCompact C ∧ ∀ (x : Space n) (r : ℝ), x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Icc s t → u x r = q) →
        ∀ (S : Set (Space n × ℝ)),
          IsOpen S → Set.EqOn (Function.uncurry u) (fun x => q) S → ∀ p ∈ S, Function.uncurry u =ᶠ[𝓝 p] fun x => q
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
